# ChatGPT Ads Library

> ChatGPT Ads Library is an independent, searchable archive of ads running across ChatGPT. It indexes ad creative, advertisers, websites, copy, descriptions, publish dates, and impression counts.

## Explore

- [Browse ads](https://chatgpt-ads-library.com/): Browse and search the full ad archive.
- [Advertisers](https://chatgpt-ads-library.com/advertisers): Every advertiser running ads, with ad counts and impressions.
- [About](https://chatgpt-ads-library.com/about): How the library works and frequently asked questions.

## Data

Each ad record includes the advertiser name and logo, the advertised website, ad copy,
a longer description, the ad screenshot, the publish date, and an impression count.
Ads can be filtered by advertiser, date range, and impressions, and searched across
advertiser names, websites, and ad text.
